title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：sweater　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sweater 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the tailor ① knitted the sweater that no customer in the shop would have noted, and he said the knitting was the whole of the week. The ② sweater, meaning the jumper itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a sweater, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sweater in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ sweater at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sweater, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the tailor said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sweater was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the jumper. The ⑥ sweater, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; sweater, he said, is either something you knit or the only word that means both a jumper and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ sweater had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ sweater of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of noting; sweater, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sweater I remember is the jumper noted in the order, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ sweater, my mother said in 2002, is the only jumper that improves by being noted; every sweater, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a jumper. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 毛衣（指裁缝铺里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 毛衣（指那件毛衣本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：knit the sweater 织这一件毛衣
D. n. 毛衣（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 毛衣之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的毛衣之事）
F. n. 毛衣（指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一件）
G. n. 毛衣、暖意（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: knitted the sweater that no customer in the shop would have noted
The sweater, meaning the jumper itself and not the needle
the sweater at the far mirror
the sweater was the whole of the matter
the sweater had become a line in an order
The sweater of the whole thing
A sweater, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: knit the sweater 意为“织这一件毛衣”，1993 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一件毛衣做了一遍。
sweater 意为“毛衣”，指那件毛衣本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
sweater 意为“毛衣”，指裁缝铺里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
sweater 意为“毛衣”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sweater 意为“毛衣、暖意”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件暖意就是那件事的全部。
sweater 意为“暖意”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件毛衣，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sweater 意为“毛衣”，指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一件，到 1998 年这一件成了订单簿里的一行。
sweater 意为“毛衣之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的毛衣之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记下。
sweater 意为“毛衣”，我记得的是订单簿里记下过的那一件，2000 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一件。
sweater 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，毛衣是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的毛衣。
